# Task: Rewrite GitHub Issue Title When Converting Issues to Tasks

## Summary
Extend the current GitHub issue rewriting functionality to also rewrite the issue title, not just the body.

## Requirements
- Locate the code that currently rewrites GitHub issue bodies for autonomous coding agents
- Add functionality to rewrite the issue title using the same prompt refinement approach
- The rewritten title should be concise and clearly summarize the task
- Maintain consistency between the rewritten title and body

## Constraints
- Do not change the existing issue body rewriting behavior
- The title rewrite should follow the same principles as the body rewrite (clear, structured, suitable for autonomous agents)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Issue title is rewritten when converting GitHub issues to task descriptions
- [ ] Rewritten title accurately reflects the refined task
- [ ] Title is concise (appropriate length for a title, not a paragraph)
- [ ] Both title and body rewriting work together cohesively
- [ ] Existing issue body rewriting functionality remains intact
